pos.title: Point of sale
pos.description: Sell at the counter from the browser, with every receipt registered with the tax authority.
pos.point1: Sell by product, barcode or variant, and take cash, card or a split bill
pos.point2: Open and close shifts, with cash in and out and a count at closing
pos.point3: Hold carts, refund sales and reprint receipts
pos.point4: Set up tills, payment terminals and manager PINs

fiscal.title: Fiscal / E-Invoice
fiscal.description: Register till receipts and invoices with the tax authority (CIS) automatically.
fiscal.point1: Every till receipt gets its NIVF, NSLF and a QR code to verify it
fiscal.point2: Sales to businesses can also be sent as e-invoices
fiscal.point3: Invoices, such as car rental invoices, are registered when they are issued
fiscal.point4: Your certificate and cash register (TCR) in one place
